top_issues: A lone WETH 0.00 header row floats above the ACCOUNTS card with no section label, so the scroll position reads as broken/empty
'send up to 175.00' / 'receive up to 0.50' and the 'owes you' caption are low-contrast gray on near-black, hard to read on a phone outdoors

top_issues: 'Verified by your runtime' is the trust payoff but is small green text below the fold of the proof hash; the strongest claim is the least prominent

top_issues: Same receipt: 'in 9 s' settlement time is green but unanchored—user can't tell if 9s is fast or a warning

Make the Proof row tappable to copy the full hash

top_issues: 'YOUR ENTITY ID' block explains routing in three sentences of jargon ('account route to you', 'inbound room') that a freelancer forwarding a payment link won't parse

Move capacity prep behind an 'Advanced' disclosure

top_issues: QR is the hero but has no amount/name watermark, so a scanned code is ambiguous if the user has several receive links
'25.50 capacity via H1' sits at the top of the amount field where a payer expects the requested amount
fixes: Overlay a small token glyph + amount on the QR center when set
Relabel the capacity hint as a footnote under 'Prepare incoming account'

top_issues: Order book depth bars are decorative gradients, not true depth, contradicting the product's 'one absolute scale' promise and misleading a DeFi power user
'1 tick = 1/10,000 USDC' is an unexplained unit that adds friction to 'tap a level'

Show tick size as a price example ('$2,498.0000') instead of a tick count

top_issues: The received amount 0.039992 is rendered in dim gray as if disabled, yet it is the single most important number on the screen

Collapse all fee lines into one 'All-in rate 2,500.50 · fees 0.01%' with details behind a tap

top_issues: A toast ('Account opening requested with zero credit') overlaps the 'Gross receive' card and the primary button is dimmed under it—core controls are obscured

Default the slider to a sane value and hide the chips/limit text behind 'Adjust credit'

top_issues: The 'Swap USDC for WETH' button overlaps the collateral slider thumb and the 'Collateral / New credit' labels—visibly broken stacking

Add a 'Total cost: X USDT + Y fee' line for the cross route

Make the dispute window a tappable 'Start dispute' row

top_issues: Five action tiles (Pay/Extend credit/Swap/Manage/Dispute) plus a 5-item legend overload the top before any balance is shown

top_issues: Filter chips are clipped mid-word ('Accou…') with no scroll cue, so users don't realize there are more filters

Add a short id or counterparty differentiator per row

top_issues: 'Frames 2 committed entries' is the audit-grade proof a treasurer wants but is phrased like a database stat, not a verifiable claim
No 'verify / open evidence' action on the receipt sheet itself; the user must navigate away
fixes: Reword to '2 on-chain signed frames · tap to verify'
Add a 'Verify evidence' button that opens the bundle

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Forget vault' sit unguarded next to each other with identical prominence; a mis-tap destroys the wallet
The 'AT THIS SCALE' demo card is clever but appears in Settings where a user expects account controls, diluting the security actions
fixes: Require a confirm + type-to-confirm on 'Forget vault'; visually separate it with a danger divider
Move the scale demo under the SCALE slider in Settings top, not the security zone

top_issues: Toggling 'Accounts' off presumably hides bilateral money but the row gives no consequence warning—dangerous for a core feature
'1 px = $10' scale unit is shown three times (header, slider value, chips) which is redundant clutter
fixes: Add an inline warning: 'Hiding accounts removes $90 promised from view'
Show the scale value once, next to the slider

top_issues: 'Fund you through H1' radio is the only option shown, so the 'WHAT HAPPENS' selector is a single choice pretending to be a decision
'up to 40.00 USDC' cap conflicts with the 150.00 Account balance card selected in TO, confusing how much can move

Tie the amount cap to the selected FROM card's available figure and label it

top_issues: FROM and TO use identical 3-card grids; the user must read 'selected' borders to know direction, which is error-prone for moving five-figure sums
'Recipient entity · leave empty for yourself' is a self-transfer footgun with no confirmation of the destination

Show a resolved destination summary ('You → your H1 account') before Sign & send

top_issues: 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' duplicates the Home breakdown; two different framings ('Yours whatever a hub does' vs 'On-chain/Reserve/Secured/Promised') risk inconsistency
Five tool tiles + three summary cards push the actual ACCOUNTS list below the fold where the operator needs it
fixes: Reuse the exact same four-way breakdown terminology as Home
Make the Accounts list the primary content and the summary a collapsible header

top_issues: A credit-extension slider and 'Receive USDC from H1' (dimmed) appear inside the Assets/Faucet screen, so a user looking for test money hits a lending form instead
'Need 74.499977 USDC more' / 'New credit 81.949975 USDC' are 6-decimal figures with no rounding—noise in a faucet context
fixes: Separate faucet top-ups from hub-credit prep into distinct cards
Round display to 2 decimals with full precision on tap

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' under every zero token is alarming boilerplate that a first-timer reads as a threat
Three zero balances plus a 0.1000 ETH gas line fill the screen with nothing actionable
fixes: Hide the 'may pull' caption until a non-zero allowance exists
Add an 'Add money' CTA in place of the empty rows

top_issues: 'Offer to the pool' is dimmed with no reason shown; the user can't tell if it's the zero amount or missing collateral
H1 POOL Available/Borrowed/Active principal all 0.00 gives no yield signal to price an offer
fixes: Show the disabled-reason inline ('enter an amount')
Add current pool APR / utilization so the 100 bps ask has context

top_issues: Hub/Token/Lend-Borrow/Amount/Term/Rate stack as six separate cards, so the lending form feels like a settings page rather than one action
'3 lanes' under H1 is undefined jargon at the very first choice
fixes: Merge into one 'New offer' card with the CTA inside it
Explain 'lanes' (asset pairs) or replace with the token list

top_issues: The board explainer ('lazy entity', 'EntityProvider', 'quorum 2 of 3') is dense protocol prose with no visual model of the board
'Nothing to take over' empty state is fine, but the primary 'add a signer / change threshold' action is missing entirely
fixes: Render the board as avatars + threshold dial instead of a paragraph
Add an 'Add signer / rotate board' CTA

top_issues: 'Save evidence bundle' is the security task's payoff but sits as a plain gray button below a wall of key/ledger rows
'nothing at risk' green is reassuring but unexplained—Kenji wants to know what would make it not-green
fixes: Make 'Save evidence bundle' a prominent primary action with a one-line description
Add a 'risk factors: 0' expansion listing what is being checked

top_issues: 'Enforceable right now $40.00' is the headline a treasurer needs, but the violet Promised $90 sits in the same bar with no 'at risk' framing
KEYS/LEDGER rows expose Signer/Entity/Runtime ids and frame numbers that overwhelm the single enforceable figure
fixes: Add a red/violet 'at risk $90' callout beside the $40 headline
Collapse raw ids behind a 'technical details' disclosure

overall.verdict: A genuinely differentiated, mostly premium dark wallet whose 'one absolute scale' and on-chain-proof ideas land strongly on Home, Receipt, Account and Sovereignty, but it is let down by jargon-heavy swap/lend flows, low-contrast secondary text, and several broken/overlapping layouts on the cross-network and assets screens. It satisfies security-minded and power users well while still blocking a true first-timer from a confident first payment.
priority_fixes: Fix the broken stacking on 05b-swap-cross(-bottom) and 12-assets-bottom: the primary CTA overlaps the collateral slider and toasts cover content—reserve a safe-area sticky footer and move toasts above it.
Collapse swap/lend fee jargon ('bps', 'lot rounding', 'tariff', 'tick', 'lanes') into a single all-in rate + $ net-received figure with details behind a tap.

Surface risk as an action, not a paragraph: on Home/Account/Sovereignty turn violet 'Promised / uncovered' into a colored 'at risk $X · Secure it' banner so Tomasz, Kenji and Ravi see exposure at a glance.
Give Maya a real onramp and a verified-recipient step: add a clear 'Add money' path from Home and replace the 64-char hash in Pay with a verified name + short id.
Raise secondary-text contrast to WCAG AA, round 6-decimal figures to 2, and stop clipping filter chips ('Accou…') and zero-balance 'may pull' noise.
